Amager og Hvidovre Hospital is a healthcare institution located within the [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] [^src4]. It is specifically noted in the national clinical quality database for atrial fibrillation (Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark) as a hospital included in the detailed hospital-level analysis for Indicator 1, where its results did not meet the required standard [^src1]. 

The hospital's performance is evaluated across multiple clinical quality indicators for the period of July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023. For [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]], which measures the proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients receiving an echocardiography, Amager og Hvidovre Hospital achieved a compliance rate of 77.1% (95% CI: 73.8–80.1) [^src2]. This performance fell below the national standard of ≥80% [^src2]. 

The hospital is also assessed on its adherence to anticoagulation treatment guidelines over time. For Indicator 4a, which tracks anticoagulation treatment coverage two years after diagnosis, the hospital met the ≥90% standard with a 90.0% compliance rate (95% CI: 85.6–93.3) [^src3]. However, for Indicator 4b, measuring treatment coverage five years post-diagnosis, the hospital recorded an 87.8% compliance rate, failing to meet the ≥90% threshold [^src4]. These metrics illustrate the hospital's mixed compliance with national standards and its role in ongoing clinical quality improvement efforts within the Danish healthcare system [^src2].
